## South Korean Equities Rise for Second Consecutive Day with Samsung Electronics as Primary Driver

A two-session KOSPI rally with Samsung as the named catalyst signals sustained institutional confidence in the semi-cycle recovery and AI demand read-through. For a tech PM, this is a cross-asset confirmation that AI infrastructure optimism is translating into EM tech flows — constructive for the broader semi supply chain thesis.

- Korean equity markets advanced for a second straight session, with Samsung Electronics explicitly named as the primary driver of gains.
- Coverage from Indian and European financial press confirms the move has cross-market visibility.
- No specific catalyst — earnings release, product event, or macro data — is identified in the headlines as the trigger for the rally.
- The Samsung-led advance is consistent with the AI and semiconductor demand optimism narrative also surfacing in other clusters.
